source_instruction: what deodorants do you have that are alcohol free and very long lasting?
query: I stopped by the food court on my way over here just now, and the new mango boba stand right by the entrance had the longest line I’ve seen all month—people were snaked all the way past the pretzel stand, holding those bright orange cups, and I swear I could smell the sweet ripe mango and chewy tapioca even from three storefronts away. I ran into my old neighbor Lila while I was waiting for my friend to grab her order, and she was telling me her rescue tabby just figured out how to open the kitchen cabinet that holds all her fancy ceramic mugs, so she’s had to stack all her heavy cookbooks in front of the door to keep him from knocking everything onto the tile floor. The weather’s been so weirdly muggy this week too, even with the breeze coming through the mall skylights, my cotton shirt was sticking a little to my shoulders before I even made it halfway down this row of stores. I’ve heard there are deodorant and antiperspirant options right in this section that are totally alcohol free, with no harsh alcohol ingredients at all, the kind that holds up well enough for regular use. I’ve also heard none of those options sit over that one price limit I always stick to.
